column1: # Compiler-private Core source parts: Core sources that are not public
# modules. Each part is attached to its public owner for loading and source
# identity, but it is not a Core module name, it is not publicly importable,
# and the Core surface ledger does not score it. This file is the parts' only
# home. Tools/agent/CoreSourceRows.jet projects these rows, in this order,
# into CORE_SOURCE_OWNED_ROWS after the Core.jet source modules.
# Columns (tab-separated): module, owner (the public owner), path, alias,
# owns (comma-separated source-local helpers the part exports), impls
# (comma-separated implementation receivers). An empty list is an empty field.
